verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Smithery documenting API versioning or a deprecation policy. The only deprecation evidence is a one-off shutdown notice that ended the API, CLI and SDK service versions on 2026-10-31. The remaining registry endpoint is undocumented, with no docs or OpenAPI surface, so there is no versioned API contract to rely on.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
